decision.observation: The card choices are Impervious (2 energy: gain 30 Block, Exhaust), Dark Embrace (2 energy: draw 1 whenever a card is Exhausted), and Dual Wield (1 energy: copy an Attack or Power in hand).
decision.hypothesis: Impervious offers the strongest immediate defense for a deck that has been taking substantial combat damage; selecting it should add it to the deck.
decision.memory: Current HP is 39/80 with 161 gold and a 14-card deck. Favor reliable defense; Impervious Exhausts, so it normally works once per combat.
